title: Design a Streaming LLM Playground
prompt: Design a web playground for authenticated users to submit generation requests, receive cancellable token streams, and save private parameter presets. Provider credentials must remain server-side. Cover request idempotency, streaming, cancellation, quotas, preset authorization, failures, and observability; provider model internals are out of scope.

response.placeholder: Separate a durable saved preset from an ephemeral generation stream, and never expose the provider key.
response.reference_answer:
## API and ownership
A request contains model/version, prompt, immutable generation parameters, and an idempotency key. Presets are private records with owner checks on every read and write. The browser never receives a provider credential.

## Stream path
The gateway authenticates, enforces per-user and global concurrency/usage limits, calls the provider with server credentials, and proxies tokens by SSE or WebSocket. A generation ID supports cancel, reconnect status, and audit records. Cancellation reaches the upstream call and marks the request terminal; retry uses a new generation unless an idempotency retry is still unresolved.

## Reliability
Persist only the metadata needed for usage, audit, and optional result retrieval; do not make client stream delivery the durability boundary. Record provider errors, time-to-first-token, completion, cancel race, cost, and quota rejections.

## Progressive Hints
1. The stream is a proxy, not a client-side provider call.
2. Presets and conversations have different retention rules.
3. Freeze parameters for one run.
